blocks.title: Let's Sing!
blocks.body: Are you ready to sing Incy Wincy Spider? It is one of the most fun songs!

blocks.title: Incy Wincy Spider
blocks.content:
Incy wincy spider climbed up the water spout,
Down came the rain and washed the spider out.

blocks.title: For Parents & Teachers
blocks.content: Encourage the child to do the hand actions while singing this rhyme to build motor skills.
